title: The Island of Secrets
note: FAIRYTALE storyteller cadence, heavy on mystery. NO on-screen sentence text (CLAUDE.md #10). Vertical 1080x1920, 177s. She REFUSES the kiss; the prince kisses her at the climax, then hides a gift box as a next-episode teaser.

lines.text: Long ago, on an island that the maps had forgotten, there stood a little house of old, weathered wood.
And in that house lived a woman whose name no one ever knew.
Her hair was dark as the sea at midnight, and they say it moved, even when the wind did not.
And her eyes... her eyes held a storm that no living soul could ever read.
Every evening she walked to the end of the dock, and waited for something that might never come.
For once, long ago, a storm had carried a gift onto her shore.
A prince. Famed across every kingdom. The wisest of mind, the strongest of arm, the name on every tongue.
She warmed him by the fire, and asked him nothing at all.
And somewhere between the rain and the morning, the two of them fell.
But when he leaned in to kiss her, she turned away, for she had seen the ring upon his hand.
He had walked her shore, and learned every colour hidden in her eyes.
Yet the ring was not hers. He belonged to a crown,
and to a queen who waited in a castle across the cold grey sea.
And still, this man whom kingdoms obeyed loved her, more than the throne, more than his own name.
Each season his pale sail returned, thin and trembling on the far horizon.
And each season, fewer believed he ever truly left.
Until the morning he held her at last, and finally, gently, he kissed her.
Then, before the tide could take him, he hid a gift. A small box, tied with ribbon, where only the patient would ever find it.
She did not see him go. She never saw the box at all.
Some say it waits there still, and that one day, she will find it.
Will she? The island, of course, will never tell.
